title: Low version projectile trajectory
description: Restore the old version of the projectile trajectory
body:
English:
Ins t higher versions of Minecraft, the final speed of a thrown object depends on the current player's speed pluhe initial speed of the object. However, in previous versions, the final speed was equal to the initial speed. This mechanism in the new version may cause players to misjudge the final landing point of the object. If it is at the end, a small mistake can cause players to lose all equipment. This data package only requires a few simple commands to restore the throwing logic of the old version. The function of the data packet consists of execute as @ a [nbt={SelecteItem: {id: "minecraft:<item ID>"}}] at @ s run tp @ s~~~, and there is only one type, so the data packet will not fail in any version that can ensure the normal operation of the instruction

The current issue with the data packet is: (1. If the offhand

Holding items such as pearls or snowballs that can be remotely launched may result in the disappearance of the placed blocks

2. In versions below 1.20, there may be strange shaking effects when holding a projectile while moving

Due to the limit of 20 ticks per second in my world, using projectiles while quickly switching between items in the inventory may result in invalid data packet

持有可以远程发射的珍珠或雪球等物品可能会导致放置的积木
方块消失
